overview: Docket lists 1940 Japan Times cartoons on the US, a 1941 rumor of US naval bases in China tied to peace talks, and a report on increasingly hostile Japanese press tone.

subfiles.title: Department of State List of Papers: Public Press—Japan
subfiles.about: A two-page archival list describes three Grew communications concerning Japanese press treatment of the United States in 1940–1941.
subfiles.summary: Docket indexes 1940 anti-US Japan Times cartoons, a 1941 rumor of US naval-base demands in China, and a report on the Japanese press's growing hostility toward the US.

interest: Shows 1940-41 US tracking of Japanese press hostility, cartoons, and a China naval-base rumor.
